DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Duodenal Atresia or Jejunal/Ileal Atresia)

The X-ray confirms a mechanical obstruction, and the combination of bilious vomiting with failure to pass meconium in a newborn is highly suggestive of an intestinal atresia. The ultrasound will further evaluate for any associated anomalies, but the clinical picture strongly points to a congenital blockage rather than malrotation with volvulus.
